exposure: Placement of baby on mother's chest after delivery
outcome: Rates of early initiation of breastfeeding (within 1 hour of birth)
Rates of exclusive breastfeeding at 42 days postpartum
cohort: Women and their live-born infants from 7 research sites in 6 countries (Kenya, Zambia, India, Pakistan, Argentina, and Guatemala)
finding: Rates of both early initiation of breastfeeding and exclusive breastfeeding at 42 days postpartum were high, except in Pakistan, and several factors were associated with these breastfeeding indicators.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was associated with failure to initiate early breastfeeding.
country: Kenya, Zambia, India, Pakistan, Argentina, Guatemala
birth_weight: Low birth weight was associated with failure to initiate early breastfeeding
